ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes are characterized by contiguous white regions. The central medial area contains a large, solid black V-shaped pigmentation block. Multiple small, discrete black circular spots are located on the left white lobe, with fewer, smaller spots on the right white lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across both lobes; numerous distinct peaks and valleys create a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the distal edges of both the left and right lobes, sweeping upward toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-15 localized dark circular pixel clusters on the left white lobe and 3-5 on the right white lobe, representing focal mottling.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, vertical high-contrast white linear mark is visible within the central black pigmentation region, just left of the vertical midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and small notches along the trailing edge; single distinct vertical scar on the central black surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation forms a sharply defined, symmetrical 'heart' or bifurcated shape against the white distal lobes.
